chunks: And whatever is in Hā from Muḥammad ibn al-Fayḍ, I have narrated it from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad ibn Masrūr—may Allah be pleased with him—from al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĀmir, from his uncle ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿĀmir, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Muḥammad ibn al-Fayḍ.

key_terms.ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ: Ibn Abī ʿUmayr; a major transmitter named in the chain
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement identifying the author’s route of narration
key_terms.عَنْ عَمِّهِ: from his uncle; indicates a familial link within the sanad/isnad
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْفَيْضِ: Muḥammad ibn al-Fayḍ; the transmitter to whom this route leads

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Muḥammad ibn al-Fayḍ in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Muḥammad ibn al-Fayḍ in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and preserving the scholarly record of how these hadith reach the compiler.
